notes: 普通港鐵網絡唔接受一般寵物，放入寵物袋亦唔代表可以上車；導盲犬同港鐵另行批准安排須分開處理。輕鐵貓狗同行係獨立特別計劃，唔適用於其他港鐵線。
notes_en: Ordinary MTR services do not accept ordinary pets; a carrier does not make them permitted. Guide dogs and separately authorised arrangements are distinct exceptions. The Light Rail Cat/Dog Carrying Scheme does not apply to other MTR networks.

notes: 小巴是否接受寵物由營辦商決定。未有該路線營辦商明確確認前，唔好當作可攜寵交通選項；唔好聲稱全港小巴一律法例禁止寵物。
notes_en: Minibus operators decide whether to accept pets. Do not recommend a minibus as pet-friendly without explicit confirmation from that route's operator. Do not describe this as a blanket legal ban on all minibuses.
